content.content:
We need to produce a travel plan for 2 people, departing from Lake Charles (presumably Lake Charles, Louisiana) visiting 2 cities in Texas, 5 days (Mar 4-8 2022). Budget $4600. Preference: accommodations where parties are allowed (maybe like Airbnb with party-friendly or hotels with event spaces). We need to output plan using submit_day_plan function for each day (5 calls). Must include day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to decide which two Texas cities to visit: maybe Austin and San Antonio (popular). Or Dallas and Houston. Considering parties allowed, maybe Austin (vibrant nightlife) and San Antonio.

Trip: Day 1 March 4: depart Lake Charles to Austin. Travel maybe drive (approx 5 hours). Provide transportation details. Breakfast maybe at home or coffee? Could be "Breakfast at home". Attractions: "Texas State Capitol, Austin; Barton Springs Pool, Austin". Lunch: "Franklin Barbecue, Austin". Dinner: "The Container Bar, Austin". Accommodation: "Party-friendly Airbnb in Downtown Austin".

Day 2 March 5: Austin day. Breakfast: "Juan in a Million". Attractions: "Zilker Park, Austin; South Congress, Austin". Lunch: "Torchy's Tacos". Dinner: "Eddie V's". Accommodation same.

Day 3 March 6: Travel to San Antonio. Transportation: "Drive from Austin to San Antonio (1.5 hours)". Breakfast: "Café No Sé". Attractions: "The Alamo, San Antonio; River Walk, San Antonio". Lunch: "Mi Tierra Café". Dinner: "The Pearl Brewery". Accommodation: "Party-friendly Airbnb near River Walk".

Day 4 March 7: San Antonio day. Breakfast: "The Guenther House". Attractions: "San Antonio Museum of Art, San Antonio; Mission San José". Lunch: "The Cove". Dinner: "Boudro's on the Riverwalk". Accommodation same.

Day 5 March 8: Return to Lake Charles. Transportation: "Drive from San Antonio to Lake Charles (approx 9 hours)". Breakfast: "Hotel breakfast". Lunch: "Stop at a local diner on the way". Dinner: "Home". Accommodation: "-" (since returning home). Or indicate "Lake Charles home". Keep within budget.

We must not ask follow-up, just produce plan. Use submit_day_plan function calls.

We need to ensure fields: day, current_city (if traveling between two cities indicate "from A to B"). transportation string. breakfast. attraction; use semicolon separated with each attraction "Name, City". lunch, dinner, accommodation.

Let's craft each day.

Day 1: current_city "Lake Charles to Austin". transportation "Drive, 5 hrs, approx 300 miles, departure 08:00, arrival 13:00". breakfast maybe "Home-cooked breakfast, Lake Charles". attraction maybe "Texas State Capitol, Austin; Barton Springs Pool, Austin". lunch "Franklin Barbecue, Austin". dinner "The Container Bar, Austin". accommodation "Party-friendly Airbnb with private backyard, Austin".

Day 2: current_city "Austin". transportation "-" (no travel). breakfast "Juan in a Million, Austin". attraction "Zilker Park, Austin; South Congress Avenue, Austin". lunch "Torchy's Tacos, Austin". dinner "Eddie V's Prime Seafood, Austin". accommodation same.

Day 3: current_city "Austin to San Antonio". transportation "Drive, 1.5 hrs, approx 80 miles, departure 09:00, arrival 10:30". breakfast "Café No Sé, Austin". attraction "The Alamo, San Antonio; River Walk, San Antonio". lunch "Mi Tierra Café, San Antonio". dinner "The Pearl Brewery, San Antonio". accommodation "Party-friendly Airbnb with large living room, San Antonio".

Day 4: current_city "San Antonio". transportation "-". breakfast "The Guenther House, San Antonio". attraction "San Antonio Museum of Art, San Antonio; Mission San José, San Antonio". lunch "The Cove, San Antonio". dinner "Boudro's on the Riverwalk, San Antonio". accommodation same.

Day 5: current_city "San Antonio to Lake Charles". transportation "Drive, 9 hrs, approx 600 miles, departure 08:00, arrival 17:00". breakfast "Hotel breakfast, San Antonio". lunch "Stop at a local diner in Houston, Texas". dinner "Home, Lake Charles". accommodation "-".

Now call submit_day_plan for each day.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
